# Boardplot

> Boardplot draws consulting-grade business charts, tables and maps as SVG or PNG, and provides responsive React components. Use its six MCP tools, CLI or React package. The local runtime needs Node.js 22.12 or newer. PowerPoint receives a chart image, with no editable chart data.

## MCP start

A chart spec has required `type` and `data` fields and optional `name`, `options`, `annotations` and `theme` fields. Pass a valid spec directly to `boardplot_render`. Check `ok`, `warnings`, `reading` and the actual output format before using the result.

- Known chart type: `boardplot_describe` returns its compact contract and a working example. Use `path` for any field that needs more detail. `detail: "full"` exports the exhaustive contract and can be large.
- Unknown chart type: `boardplot_list` lists the available types and use cases.
- Example needed: `boardplot_fixtures` with `type` and `id` returns one runnable spec. Listings are paginated; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` with the same filters.
- Fixed container: `boardplot_measure` reports the size the spec needs at the requested width.
- Boardplot defect: `boardplot_feedback` drafts a report for the user to review and submit.

For supported row mappings, render and measure accept a local file through `rowsFile` and `columns`, or inline `rows`. The file route reads source numbers directly. The six MCP tools have corresponding CLI commands without the `boardplot_` prefix. CLI commands use positional arguments and flags.

## Chart references

- [column](docs/reference/column.md): Vertical bars, grouped or stacked
- [bar](docs/reference/bar.md): Horizontal bars per item
- [line](docs/reference/line.md): Lines and areas over time
- [dimswitch](docs/reference/dimswitch.md): KPIs by one dimension and period, from sums
- [table](docs/reference/table.md): Management table with totals; rows [label,id]
- [waterfall](docs/reference/waterfall.md): Bridge; rows label,value[,type]
- [kpi](docs/reference/kpi.md): Single-metric card
- [combo](docs/reference/combo.md): Columns with line or area overlays
- [variance](docs/reference/variance.md): Variance tier against PY, PL or FC
- [bullet](docs/reference/bullet.md): KPI rows with bands and target
- [bartable](docs/reference/bartable.md): Table rows with stacked bars, one panel per measure
- [pvm](docs/reference/pvm.md): Price, volume and mix bridge
- [pie](docs/reference/pie.md): Pie or doughnut of shares
- [status](docs/reference/status.md): Entity by period state matrix
- [heatmap](docs/reference/heatmap.md): Row by column matrix
- [gantt](docs/reference/gantt.md): Timeline with spans and events
- [scatter](docs/reference/scatter.md): XY/bubble; rows x,y[,size,label,group]
- [funnel](docs/reference/funnel.md): Stage funnel with conversion rates
- [pareto](docs/reference/pareto.md): Sorted columns with cumulative curve
- [mekko](docs/reference/mekko.md): Variable-width stacked columns
- [sparkline](docs/reference/sparkline.md): One series as a mini line
- [treemap](docs/reference/treemap.md): Part of a whole as nested areas
- [sankey](docs/reference/sankey.md): Flows from sources to targets in stages; rows source,target,value
- [grid](docs/reference/grid.md): Facets and metric stacks on one category axis
- [slope](docs/reference/slope.md): Two-point slope lines
- [dot](docs/reference/dot.md): Dots, dumbbells or lollipops
- [cohort](docs/reference/cohort.md): Retention by cohort and period
- [choropleth](docs/reference/choropleth.md): Region map coloured by value
- [butterfly](docs/reference/butterfly.md): Two mirrored bar panes
- [likert](docs/reference/likert.md): Diverging bars for survey scales
- [histogram](docs/reference/histogram.md): Equal-width bins of raw values; rows value
- [box](docs/reference/box.md): Box plots of raw observations; rows category,value[,categoryLabel,date]
- [waffle](docs/reference/waffle.md): Share of a whole as a grid of cells
- [pyramid](docs/reference/pyramid.md): Mirrored bands on one scale
- [diagram](docs/reference/diagram.md): Node and edge diagrams, including system architecture
- [tilemap](docs/reference/tilemap.md): Equal-size region tiles
- [creative](docs/reference/creative.md): Ad-creative review card (early alpha)
